decisions.reason: Inspected the original coherent full-content sweep, including title, subtitle and notice, closed disclosure; all six incident labels/severities, the c unavailable reason, no-selection summary, action label and entire footer. Every required visible word is retained and readable over the sweep with no ellipsis or clipped word. Collapsed guidance and unselected dossiers are intentionally hidden. Oversized words break across characters at the narrow enlarged-text width; the brief expressly permits that fallback, and the following line retains the remaining characters.

The complete original exact-state sweep shows distinct title/subtitle/notice, disclosure, timeline cards, severity/reason text, summary, action and footer areas. No unintended collision or occlusion is visible; closed disclosure does not leave dossier text over other content. Viewport-edge cropping is resolved by overlapping original frames; contact-sheet column cuts are not component collisions.
